sections.label: The opening
sections.line: Run your own sgit server in your account and region, deployed from CI with the site factory's pattern.
sections.para: One image, S3, an access token, OIDC, checks.

sections.label: In short
sections.line: Your own server; one image; keys never reach it; from CI; no AWS keys; check, deploy, tear down; package it.

sections.label: Why your own environment
sections.line: Sensitive data raises where it lives and who runs the server; your own account and region answers it.
sections.para: Ciphertext moves; the trust model does not.

sections.label: What you deploy
sections.line: One open-source Docker image, configured by environment variables, with memory, disk or S3 storage.
sections.para: CloudFormation templates for Lambda, Fargate and EC2, in beta.

sections.label: The pipeline pattern
sections.line: Protected environment, OIDC, trust one repo and environment, least privilege, checks, smoke tests, teardown.

sections.label: Step by step, on AWS
sections.line: Region, OIDC provider, deploy role, environment and secrets, image in ECR, check, deploy, point sgit at it.

sections.label: Package it: an Action and a skill
sections.line: A proposed sgit-deploy GitHub Action and a skill for agents.
sections.para: Or a request committed to a repository.

sections.label: The prompt for your Claude
sections.line: A prompt to set it up with your own Claude, one step at a time.

sections.label: What this does not claim
sections.line: Templates in beta; the job is a sketch to prove in my account; keys still matter; other clouds undocumented.

sections.label: Where this comes from
sections.line: The SG/Send deployment guides vault, its repository, the factory's docs and sgit.ai.
